name: craft3d
description: The craft3d engine behind the /3d-model, /wireframe and /cinematic Claude Code commands: library, viewer, examples, the headless check tool and the film renderer.

scripts.setup: npm install && npx playwright install chromium && node tools/install.mjs
scripts.setup:cad: python3 -m venv .ocp && .ocp/bin/pip install --quiet cadquery-ocp numpy && .ocp/bin/python -c "import OCP, numpy; print('CAD tools ready: .ocp/bin/python tools/step2mesh.py')"
scripts.setup:film: npm install --no-save ffmpeg-static@5 && node -e "console.log('ffmpeg ready for tools/film.mjs:', require('ffmpeg-static'))"
